product_positioning.tagline: leveraged-etp-risk-lab is a zero-dependency Python CLI for planning daily-reset leveraged ETF/ETP risk scenarios. It models product terms, deterministic scenario paths, daily reset leverage, management-fee drag, path decay versus a simple multiple, stop-loss and take-profit bands, portfolio exposure aggregation, and plain-language warnings.
